title: AFL star Adam Cerra marries Claudia Piva in intimate ceremony at the Old Treasury Building in Melbourne
text:
By Kinta Walsh-Cotton for Daily Mail Australia
Published: 07:34 GMT, February 9, 2025 | Updated: 08:25 GMT, February 9, 2025
Adam Cerra and his fiancé Claudia Piva escaped in the Victorian Marriage Registry on Saturday, only three months after they committed themselves.
The 25 -year -old Carlton’s star stood on November to propose to his love, and it seems that the happy couple was very anxious to marry.
Sharing their votes in front of a small group of friends and family during the weekend, the couple married in the old treasure building in East Melbourne.
The AFL player put on a classic Menzclub black tone suit for the transcendental occasion, clinging to Claudia when the newly married left the place.
Claudia looked every centimeter the blush girlfriend with a short white dress that presented a conservative neckline and a sleeveless feature.
It was a dress very similar to the one he wore during his chickens party in January.
